eurostile-becane.$description: Custom Eurostile variant is the sole typeface across all scales. Used uppercase at 8px with 0.04em tracking for nav, buttons, labels, and micro-copy — the high tracking and small size force labels to read as gallery placards rather than UI. Bold 30px anchors the hero 'COLLECTION' wordmark. Substitutes: Eurostile, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial — the geometric warmth of Eurostile is the closest system match; fallback to Helvetica Neue retains the uppercase utility feel.
